title: The Buildout
description: AI infrastructure spending collides with power limits, closed ports and a shooting war. See the week's events before the market does.

companies.name: Atlas Cloud
companies.description: The largest cloud platform: vast fleets of rented servers, and one of the world's biggest buyers of chips and grid electricity.

companies.name: Helix Compute
companies.description: Designs the AI accelerator chips every data center is fighting over; fabless, so the parts are built for it by outside contract fabs.

companies.name: Meridian Chips
companies.description: Chipmaker a generation behind the leaders, with spare fab capacity and a catalogue of good-enough parts when first-choice supply runs out.

companies.name: Foundry One
companies.description: Contract manufacturer that fabricates other companies' chip designs; its few leading-edge lines are the ones the advanced industry queues for.

companies.name: Broadline Devices
companies.description: Makes the high-speed network switches and custom interconnect silicon that wire data-center clusters together; ships hardware worldwide by sea.

companies.name: Agora Social
companies.description: Social network funded by targeted ads; the targeting works by tracking users across other apps and sites.

companies.name: Green Current
companies.description: Renewable power producer with contracted wind, solar and storage; sells firm electricity to grids, factories and data centers.

companies.name: Titan Energy
companies.description: Integrated oil-and-gas major: pumps crude, pipes natural gas, and refines the jet fuel and diesel the transport world runs on.

companies.name: Union Aerospace
companies.description: Builds commercial airliners; its long-delayed next-generation widebody is still waiting on regulator sign-off.

companies.name: ParcelWorks
companies.description: Expedited parcel-and-freight network moving urgent cargo by air and truck; owns cargo jets and van fleets, and not a single ship.

companies.name: Orchard
companies.description: Premium phone and laptop maker; earns on devices and App Bazaar store fees rather than ads, and imports finished hardware from Asia by container ship.

companies.name: Redline Motors
companies.description: EV maker; the battery pack — lithium, cobalt, nickel — is the largest cost in every vehicle it builds.
